thread:
maya-csm: Heads-up — PulseNova just messaged that two product teams (Search + Analytics) onboarded this morning and they've already hit ~3x baseline QPS after batch sync. They want guidance on cost and whether we should move them to Dedicated. Customer says they might add 3 more teams next quarter. @olga-ae any renewal risk flags?

olga-ae: Renewal not at risk; this looks like expansion. Had a finance touchpoint — budget cycle in July. If we propose a committed block we can lock in the spend and reduce unit price.

sam-se: Recommend immediate action: 1) schedule a 90-min capacity + tuning workshop with their infra team; 2) enable prefix caching and increase batch_size to 16 for embedding routes; 3) run cost projection. I can prep config.

li-onboard: Onboarding notes: Search team used embeddings API with model=redwood-embed-xxl-quant; they reported some quality drift on edge cases. Captured two failing prompts. I'll add them to evals.

maya-csm: Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. Also need SOW addendum for +3 teams. @olga-ae can you draft pricing options (committed vs burst)?

olga-ae: Draft in progress. Quick Q: do we propose Dedicated with autoscale or Dedicated + burst credits? leaning to committed + burst.

sam-se: Example suggestion for batch call:
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-xxl-quant",
  "inputs": [...],
  "batch_size": 16,
  "max_tokens": 0,
  "cache": { "prefix": true }
}
```

li-onboard: Pasting 2 failing prompts -> "medical discharge summary abbreviations" and "financial ledger rounding edge case" — moving to evals board: https://redwood.atlassian/boards/123

deploy-bot: Canary for redwood-embed-xxl-quant queued to us-west-2 for perf test (ID: canary-8791).

maya-csm: Action items: sam to run cost sim and perf run, li to upload evals, olga to draft SOW options. I'll own scheduling and customer comms. @sam-se can you share the perf run results by EOD tomorrow?

sam-se: Yep. Will run peak-3x sim + latency P99. Expect initial numbers by 24h. :eyes:

olga-ae: Noted. Also capture their ask about audit logs and KMS — will add as optional line item.

maya-csm: One potential risk — customer mentioned 'quant artifacts' on legal docs. If we see regression on those prompts, that could slow the +3 team rollout. Keep eval gating.

li-onboard: I'll set up a canary eval with the failing prompts and add pass/fail gate to their onboarding checklist.

maya-csm: Thanks all — I'll post the meeting invite and update the account playbook afterward. Closing for now :thumbsup:
